items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He'd put you in mind of Mitchell Fridge in there.

ctx.x: history of the life. Joe Lewis was a popular name about that time.

Yeah. Played plenty of piano, Dixieland man. He figured he plays a lot of jobs now that he figured he'd come back in the union. Oh, he'd play on any kind of old broken piano. He'd put you in mind of Mitchell Fridge in there. Played all over the Bad Keys. Doesn't worry, man. No. Well, anyway. And sometimes they used to use
little Sammy Hopton. Mm-hmm. But I hardly see him anymore.
